description: Visual editor for TechDocs (MkDocs) pages, with the same Markdown fidelity as the Backstage plugin
config.openVisualByDefault: Open pages of a MkDocs `docs_dir` in the visual editor instead of the Markdown text. Use **Reopen Editor With…** to switch to the text.
config.images.maxSizeMB: Largest image, in MB, that the visual editor saves to the `assets` folder of the docs. Images go into the repository: large files weigh on every clone and on publishing.
config.local.publishPanel: Show the **Publishing** panel in the Explorer: save a draft to a branch, open a pull request, follow the checks and send it, without leaving VS Code. Needs a clone with a GitHub remote.
config.github.scopes: Scopes requested when signing in to GitHub. Use `public_repo` for public repositories only.
config.branchPattern: Name of the branch created for a draft when you are on the default branch. `{login}` is your GitHub login and `{path}` the page path.
config.drafts.skipCi: **Save draft** adds `[skip ci]` to the commit message, so the pipeline only runs on **Save and check**.
config.verification.mode: Where the checks come from. The repository `.techdocs-editor.yaml` wins over this setting.
config.verification.mode.auto: The pipeline when the repository has one (workflows or required checks), otherwise the formatting check of the editor
config.verification.mode.pipeline: Always wait for the checks of the pipeline
config.verification.mode.editor: Only the formatting check of the editor
config.verification.startTimeoutSeconds: Seconds to wait for the first check before warning that nothing started.
config.verification.checkHelp: Plain-language message shown when a check fails, by check name. Example: `{ "Links": "A link points to a page that does not exist." }`
config.polling.intervalSeconds: Seconds between check queries while something is running. Nothing is queried while the window is in the background.
config.polling.idleIntervalSeconds: Seconds between queries when nothing is running.
command.checkDocs: Check the documentation of the repository
command.prepareDocs: Prepare the documentation in this repository
config.templates.paths: More folders with templates, relative to the workspace folder: page templates (`.md` files with a `template:` block) and site templates (subfolders with a `template.yml`). They come after `.techdocs/templates/` of the site and of the workspace, which are always read.
config.templates.repository: Company-wide templates from a GitHub repository: `owner/repo`, optionally with a folder and a branch or tag (`acme/docs-templates/templates@v3`), and the host for GitHub Enterprise (`ghe.acme.com/acme/docs-templates`). Same format as `.techdocs/templates/`. They come after the repository's templates and before the built-in ones. Read when the template list opens, at most once an hour, and kept for offline use. In an untrusted workspace, only the user setting counts.
config.templates.builtIn: Show the templates that come with the extension. Turn off to offer only the repository templates.
